description: An international consortium of researchers and biosecurity watchdogs publishes a joint report demonstrating that current AI models can now design functional, transmissible human pathogens given only minimal input, using publicly available tools and open-weight models. The report includes redacted examples and calls for urgent global coordination on DNA synthesis screening. While not a live release, the findings are peer-reviewed and replicated across three labs, forcing regulatory bodies to confront the reality of democratized bio-risk.
